no_adcom_quote.quote: Although selexipag is a new molecular entity, its approval raised no issues that would justify an Advisory Committee meeting, and none was held. The drug is not the first in its class, and the safety profile is similar to that of other drugs approved for this indication.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the UPTRAVI (selexipag) NDA207947 application. The Division Director memo, cross-discipline team leader review, medical review, and the clinical filing review all state that none was held because selexipag is not first-in-class, the study design was acceptable, and the application raised no significant safety/efficacy issues. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval; the OtherR review notes only in hindsight that a meeting might have been considered had the mortality findings been better understood at the start of review.
